phases.name: Pre-PCI Hydration & Prep
phases.clinical_note: Ensure adequate oral hydration, verify antiplatelet status

meals.name: Early Light Dinner
meals.notes: Clear broth, steamed chicken or lentils

templates.focus_note: Keep hydrated and calm before interventional catheterization.

phases.name: Puncture Site & Antiplatelet Phase
phases.clinical_note: Strict access site care (groin or wrist). Dual antiplatelet compliance.

advance_criteria.description: Puncture site healed, no bleeding or hematoma

meals.name: Low-Sodium Mediterranean Breakfast
meals.notes: Avocado on whole grain toast, berries

meals.name: Cardioprotective Lunch
meals.notes: Mixed greens, grilled salmon/tofu, lemon olive oil dressing

meals.name: Light High-Fiber Dinner
meals.notes: Lentils with spinach and brown rice

instructions: No heavy lifting > 5 lbs with punctured wrist or arm for 48 hours
Avoid strenuous stair climbing if femoral access was used

checks.name: Groin or Wrist Puncture Site
checks.target: No swelling, firmness, bleeding, or bruising spreading

checks.name: Chest Sensation Check
checks.target: No recurrence of angina or pressure

templates.focus_note: Protect the vascular entry point and adhere strictly to blood thinner therapy.
